actions.name: diabolical restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .mmChain000000000]] attacks and uses [[/item .mmConjureInferna]].

actions.name: conjure infernal chain
actions.desc: The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=9vCVJrzUZL0ra4w2]], [[lookup @target.affects.labels.statblock activity=9vCVJrzUZL0ra4w2]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=9vCVJrzUZL0ra4w2]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. Success: The chain disappears.

actions.name: unnerving gaze
actions.desc: Trigger: A [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=btp6NZvx465nxWTF]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see starts its turn within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=btp6NZvx465nxWTF]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and can see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Response—Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=btp6NZvx465nxWTF]], the triggering [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=btp6NZvx465nxWTF]]. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the end of its turn. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

actions.name: chain
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from one of two chains, and it has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the grapple ends.
